snippet.title: Zatch Bell! Mamodo Fury Update - F3 Entry Trailer
snippet.description:
General enhancement pack for the classic GC game.

Vote for my entry: https://strawpoll.com/ajnE1V62NnW

Download the xdelta patch: https://mega.nz/file/W5MRlCra#I7OBsXJ2cxxUyHXP9M_418sGxPsHSzCThOEwPoHKPrA

Must be applied to a 1:1 copy.
MD5 of the patched file: 281FD93E580AB87F5F8580009F10F863


UPDATE Aug10: I was notified that this mod doesn't work on nintendont.
This is because some of the memory used for the new code is also used by nintendont.
To fix this I moved all the code from this area to more generic (and hopefully) unused space.
Instead of updating the xdelta patch, I'm providing an additional xdelta patch to be applied AFTER the main patch: https://mega.nz/file/e1VFHabD#NwB-GJzXk1AO-6G0xIk3RWuD_-eIslufZsJ9uXddRDQ

MD5: 5509454791E6A5EB9545D4EC418C8C51


NOTE: Tsao-lon and Pamoon's attacks will only work as Player 2, and Pamoon's spells will only work on the Star Room stage. Eventually, I hope to fix this.

I recommend trying this with a completed savefile to quickly access all characters.
https://mega.nz/file/S4Nj3SrC#ogGhuUb0D-NL4cqROPsNZVDN0aGYPA8QTkir2icAuQI

I struggled to find a way to efficiently switch between Japanese and English dubs, I settled on holding at least the A button at boot or after a reset, but I found this tedious if the user always wants the Japanese dub, so I decided to also include an alternative method that works by signaling it to the game by writing a flag to memory.

The easiest way to write this flag is via cheat code:

Always load Japanese voices
021906BE 00000001
